say:1:1524628001:0.text: The flavor's perfect, and I can tell just from the aroma! You're a genius at cooking!
say:1:1524628001:0.source_cn: 没错，没错，就是这个味道！光闻这香味我就知道，这就是我...

say:2:1524628002:0.text: Come, fetch a bowl and dig in. You made the dish, so you get the first bite!
say:2:1524628002:0.source_cn: 来吧，快盛一碗尝尝！这道菜是你做出来的，你理应吃第一口！

narration:3:1524628003:0.text: Encouraged by Brownpot's enthusiasm, you take a piece of fish and put it into your mouth...
narration:3:1524628003:0.source_cn: 在棕点热情的邀请下，你夹了一块鱼肉，放入口中品尝……

say:4:1524628004:0.text: Absolutely delicious! The coconut aroma enhances the freshness of the fish, and Brownpot's special spices give the stew a rich yet delicate flavor. Ten out of ten!
say:4:1524628004:0.source_cn: 鱼肉出乎意料地好吃！椰香完全带出了鱼的鲜味，再配上棕点...

say:5:1524628005:0.text: Looks like you're enjoying it! Top up the bowl so I can try some too! Now, let me tell you about the next dish I'm working on...
